Google autocomplete (hl=si, gl=lk) — colloquial Sinhala loanwords are what people type in Sinhala script: “කෑම ඕඩර්”, “කෑම ඕඩර් බාරගනු ලැබේ”, “ඔන්ලයින් ඕඩර්”, “ඔන්ලයින් කෑම ඕඩර්”, “කෑම පාර්සල්”, “බත් පාර්සල්”, “කෑම ඩිලිවරි”, “කේටරින් සර්විස්”, “කෑම මෙනු”, “සෙට් මෙනු”, “මෙනු කාඩ්”, “කොමිස් මුදල”; formal “ඇණවුම් කිරීම”, “කෑම ඇණවුම්” also appear

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pickme.merchant.live&hl=si — merchant side: “ඔබේ අවන්හල හෝ ගබඩාව”, “වෙළඳ හවුල්කරුවෙකු”, “ඩෙලිවරි රයිඩර්ස්”

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=lk.bhasha.helapay&hl=si — HelaPOS (Sri Lankan, Sinhala-first): title “පොඩි බිස්නස්වලට QR”, “ඇප් එක”, “POS (Point-of-Sales)”, “නොමිලේ ඩවුන්ලෝඩ්”, “LankaQR”
https://ikman.lk/si/ads/sri-lanka?query=food%20truck — Sinhala UI (ඔබේ දැන්විම පළ කරන්න, සෙවුම සුරකින්න, ස්ථානය, රු 90,000) but the ad itself is titled in Latin “Food Truck” (Matara)

https://posmasters.lk/ — LK restaurant POS vendor (English site): “KOT/BOT” kitchen tickets, cloud POS
https://ft.lk/other-sectors/kottuville-on-wheels-sri-lankas-first-food-truck/57-143808 and https://www.life.lk/foodfactor/The-Food-Truck-Culture/16698/30 — LK English press uses “food truck”
en.wikipedia langlinks — si: “වීදි ආහාර” (Street food); no Sinhala article for Food truck
confidence: Med — address form, the Latin “food truck”, ඇණවුම්/ඕඩර්, පාර්සල් (takeaway), මෙනුව and the fact that Sri Lankans search in ENGLISH are confirmed (autocomplete + PickMe/ikman/HelaPOS). Pay at Hatch wording, KDS, combo, time slot and plan names are Low (no Sri Lankan pickup-at-a-stall wording found). csvRows are what the research tool (WebSearch, US-indexed) returned for the exact query “food truck ඇණවුම් පද්ධතිය”; local Google LK ranks were not visible. Lengths are counted in code points; Sinhala vowel signs inflate the count, so a few descriptions read shorter than their 152–162 code points.
decisions: Sri Lankans search in English (every Sinhala-script food-truck/POS query had zero autocomplete; English ones had ten). Recommend Sinhala pages that keep “food truck”, “POS”, “KDS”, “WhatsApp” in Latin inside Sinhala sentences (as PickMe and HelaPOS do) so titles also match English queries; consider making en-LK / English the default for LK and Sinhala the alternative.

Register: formal ඇණවුම / ඇණවුම් කරන්න in titles, headings and buttons (PickMe, Wikipedia); the colloquial loanword ඕඩර් (and ඔන්ලයින්) is what people type — used in secondaryTerms/storeKeywords. Decide whether body copy may use ඕඩර්. “ඔන්ලයින්” chosen over formal “මාර්ගගත” (rare in speech).

Pay at Hatch: “රැගෙන යන විට ගෙවීම” (feature, = pay when you take it away) / “ස්ථානයේදී ගෙවන්න” (button, = pay on the spot). Avoid “Cash on Delivery”, “ලැබුණු පසු ගෙවීම”, “ඩිලිවරි” — PickMe’s COD wording. Low confidence: native check needed.
Sinhala conjuncts need ZERO WIDTH JOINER (U+200D) in ්‍ර / ්‍ය (ශ්‍රී, ප්‍රශ්න, ව්‍යාපාර, යන්ත්‍රය) — translators and tooling must not strip it.
Messaging: WhatsApp is the dominant business chat in Sri Lanka (Deonde lists WhatsApp ordering); Viber is also used — WhatsApp auto-reply can be featured.
Payments: LankaQR is the local QR standard (HelaPOS, Deonde); pickup-at-truck card/QR wording could mention it.
Order button: no statutory button wording found for Sri Lanka (Consumer Affairs Authority Act No. 9 of 2003 has none known); market norm “ඇණවුම් කරන්න”.
